title: Zendesk pricing - $19-$150+ per agent/month across Support and Suite tiers
clean_text: Zendesk's simpler Support Team plan starts at $19 per agent per month. The Suite product line starts at $55/agent/month (annual billing) for Suite Team, $89/agent/month for Suite Growth, and $115/agent/month for the most popular Suite Professional tier, with Enterprise Suite configurations reaching $150+ per agent per month. Every add-on, including Copilot ($50/agent/month) and the Advanced AI add-on ($50/agent/month), is priced per agent on top of the base Suite plan. Buyers with 25+ seats or multi-year commitments commonly negotiate below list price.
